name_vi: Giỏ giữ bánh dẹt có nắp
description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A low round basket has a lift-off woven lid and a blank washable fabric liner. Side: Its squat cylinder shows a continuous broad bound rim. Rear: The back has no handle or hinge and repeats the closed woven wall. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A low round basket has a lift-off woven lid and a blank washable fabric liner. Side: Its squat cylinder shows a continuous broad bound rim. Rear: The back has no handle or hinge and repeats the closed woven wall. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.. Style Rustic: sturdy handmade character and visible bindings. Relative size compact within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: open square lattice made from wider flat strips. Finish: deep walnut-brown dye with visible fiber grain. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, wood/bamboo support only where described, and only specified plain secondary materials. Do not add rigid frames or legs to flexible mats or other products that do not specify them. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, allowing a modest downward elevation for a low horizontal product so its woven surface is visible. Keep its natural resting orientation; never stand mats or trivets upright. No three-quarter azimuth or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
